description.value: A landmark pub on Sooke Road, the 17 Mile House has been welcoming travellers since 1894 — originally an inn and way-station seventeen miles from Victoria City Hall. The building retains its rustic, olde English character, complete with a crackling fireplace, bay windows overlooking a pub garden, and a dog-friendly backyard patio. It also holds a Guinness-awarded 'Best Guinness Pour in Town' distinction and hosts an annual outdoor music festival called Sookapalooza each July.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the pub is open and operating. The phone number 250-642-5942 and address 2038 Gillespie Road are corroborated across the front page and about/events/menu page footers, though the /contact/ subpage body lists a conflicting address of '5126 Sooke Road' — this internal inconsistency is flagged as a concern. The contact page title 'Pick Ups and Reservations' confirms takeout is available; the Mediterranean Flatbread Pizza is explicitly described as 'A veggie lover's delight,' confirming at least one vegetarian menu option.
concerns: Address inconsistency on website: the /contact/ subpage body lists '5126 Sooke Road, Sooke, BC V9Z 0E2' as the location, while all page footers (including the contact page footer) and OSM consistently show '2038 Gillespie Road, Sooke, BC V9Z 0E2'. The footer address is used here as it is consistent with OSM and the majority of website evidence, but the contact page body may need updating.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, clearly open pub and restaurant on the Sooke Road cycling corridor, operating for over 130 years. On-site liquor store, dog-friendly patio, and food service make it a useful stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: The pub also operates an on-site liquor store, which may be of interest to directory users. The about page mentions a hitching post — a nod to its historical character that adds to its appeal as a distinctive waypoint.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Mediterranean Flatbread Pizza is described as 'A veggie lover's delight' with pesto, artichoke hearts, sundried tomatoes, red onion, olives, and feta. Soup & Salad section also listed. No GF or vegan options explicitly confirmed
